categories.main_business_segments: Shandong Nanshan Aluminium Co., Ltd. operates a complete aluminum processing industry chain including power generation, alumina production, electrolytic aluminum, casting, aluminum profiles, hot-rolled, cold-rolled, foil rolling, and recycled aluminum. Its product portfolio covers upstream products like electricity, alumina, and aluminum alloy ingots, and downstream products such as aluminum plates and strips (automotive plates, aerospace plates, can materials), aluminum profiles (industrial and architectural), and aluminum foil. The company serves multiple end markets including automotive, aerospace, packaging, construction, transportation, and new energy sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced aluminum processing technologies including hot rolling, cold rolling, foil rolling, extrusion for aluminum profiles, and recycling technologies for high-quality secondary aluminum. It emphasizes innovation in high-strength, lightweight, corrosion-resistant aluminum alloys for automotive and aerospace applications. The company integrates green and low-carbon technologies, such as energy-efficient electrolytic aluminum production and comprehensive recycling systems, supported by a strong R&D infrastructure including a scientific research institute and multiple technology platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include automotive manufacturers, aerospace companies (notably supplying to COMAC, Airbus, and Boeing), packaging producers (can manufacturers), construction and architectural firms, and new energy sectors such as electric vehicle battery producers. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a focus on high-end aluminum products for transportation, aerospace, packaging, and industrial applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and major production facilities in Shandong Province. It has significant overseas operations and investments in Southeast Asia, especially Indonesia (Bintan Industrial Park), as well as subsidiaries and sales offices in the United States, Europe, and Singapore. The overseas presence supports raw material sourcing, production, and global sales expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shandong Nanshan Aluminium is an integrated player covering upstream raw material processing (alumina production, electrolytic aluminum), midstream casting and alloying, and downstream deep processing into various aluminum products. It controls a vertically integrated supply chain from raw materials to finished high-value aluminum products, including recycling and resource recovery, positioning itself as a full-spectrum aluminum industry chain operator.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven development focusing on high-end manufacturing and deep processing of aluminum products. R&D efforts target automotive lightweight materials, aerospace-grade aluminum alloys, and green low-carbon technologies including recycling and energy efficiency. It aims to expand high-value product capacity, enhance product quality, and achieve technological breakthroughs to overcome international barriers. The company also emphasizes digitalization, smart manufacturing, and sustainable development aligned with national policies and global trends.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of aluminum products across the value chain, including electricity, alumina, electrolytic aluminum, aluminum alloy ingots, and processed aluminum products such as plates, profiles, and foils. Sales occur via direct sales and distribution channels domestically and internationally, with pricing linked to market indices like LME and domestic aluminum prices plus processing fees. The company also earns income from recycling services and financial investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shandong Nanshan Aluminium is a leading domestic aluminum processing enterprise with a strong market position in automotive and aerospace aluminum products. It competes with other major Chinese and international aluminum producers and processors, including Press Metal Aluminium Holdings Berhad. The company differentiates itself through its integrated supply chain, high-end product portfolio, technological innovation, and global footprint, maintaining a competitive edge in high-value aluminum markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 33.48 billion, a 16.06% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 4.83 billion, up 39.03%. Total assets reached RMB 70.26 billion with steady growth. The company maintains strong cash flow generation and has increased R&D investment to RMB 1.39 billion. It has a stable dividend payout policy with a cumulative cash dividend ratio of 40.92% in 2024, reflecting robust financial health and growth momentum.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, high-performance aluminum products tailored for demanding applications in automotive lightweighting, aerospace, and packaging. It offers a vertically integrated supply chain ensuring cost control, quality assurance, and supply stability. Its commitment to green and sustainable production, including advanced recycling technologies and low-carbon initiatives, provides competitive differentiation. The company’s strong R&D capabilities and certifications for key customers underpin its reputation as a reliable supplier of premium aluminum materials.
